title: Proposed Budget Expenditures (Fiscal Year 2019)
description: Data Dictionary: Label Definition Definition Source Fund.Name: The type of fund where the expenses and revenues are tracked. Office of Management and Budget Dept.Name: The department, agency or category associated with the expenditure. Office of Management and Budget Account.Name: The account name as outlined in the City’s financial tracking system. Office of Management and Budget Amount The amount (in dollars) that the City budgeted for anticipated expenditure. A negative number reflects an adjustment to other associated revenues.
